profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Intuit | Distributed Systems & AI Infrastructure | LLM Inference, Model Hosting & Agent Quality
profile.summary:
I’m a Staff Software Engineer at Intuit working on distributed systems and AI infrastructure. My work spans LLM inference infrastructure, self-service model hosting, multi-region reliability, and platforms for annotation and agent quality.

I combine hands-on engineering with team technical leadership, helping turn complex platform requirements into reliable systems that other teams can use and operate.

My current focus is annotation and agent-quality platforms, building on my experience in model serving and machine learning infrastructure. I’m interested in challenging infrastructure problems at the intersection of distributed systems, production AI, and developer platforms.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead architecture and hands-on engineering for shared AI infrastructure at Intuit, spanning LLM inference, self-service model hosting, and agent-quality platforms.

• Lead engineering for an expert-in-the-loop annotation platform supporting agent teams, including configurable workflows, real-time feedback, and access controls.

• Drive cross-team development of agent-quality feedback infrastructure, extending annotation capabilities toward versioned workflows and integrated evaluation.

• Architect self-service model-hosting infrastructure that simplifies onboarding and deployment of open-source and fine-tuned models across accelerator platforms.

• Define technical approaches for production reliability, observability, and multi-region disaster recovery, making infrastructure capabilities accessible to downstream teams.

• Guide inference performance and hardware decisions through workload benchmarking and evaluation of serving configurations, quantization, batching, and parallelism.

• Set platform technical direction, mentor engineers, and guide implementation while remaining hands-on across services and deployment infrastructure.

Big data project for processing high volume of logs and Visualizing data of it
- Created data pipeline using flume, Kafka, Spark and Cassandra/ ElasticSearch
- Wrote flume interceptor, Kafka producer and Consumer to extract and transform the data out of log files

- Customized node-red to provide flow like GUI to personalize front end Visualization

positions.title: Instructional Student Assistant
positions.description:
Instructional Student Assistant for Subject CMPE 256- Large Scale Analytics for Fall-2017

Demonstrated usage of Saprk MlLib and ML packages to perform machine learning tasks.
Presented usage of PySpark and relation with SciKit Learn.
Presented usage of User based and Item based recommendation systems using Apache Mahout Library.
Designed and demonstrated Recommendation systems using Spark ALS and Matrix Factorization.
Presented tutorial on how to use Spark Graphx's page rank implementation.
Helped students with tool implementation and environment setup.

projects.title: Chatbot for Technical Support
projects.description:
Deep learning based Chatbot to provide answers for Ubuntu questions.

- Trained Dual Encoder RNN for Question Answer retrieval system with different cell types.
- Compared results for cell types with recall@1, such as LSTM (88.26%), GRU (91.12%) and basic RNN cell (36.56%)
- To filter out probable answers, trained a neural network with (66%) accuracy to extract tags from question.
- Created a flask based rest server to host system on AWS and integrate with Amazon Alexa.

projects.title: Log Processing and Visualization- Big Data
projects.description:
•	Created data pipeline using flume, Kafka, Spark and Cassandra
•	Wrote flume interceptor, Kafka producer, and Consumer to extract and transform the data out of log files
•	Designed spark streaming service that can read the data from kafka and insert into Cassandra
•	Customized node-red to provide flow like GUI to personalize front end Visualization
Developed nodejs, angularJS based front end system, to visualize logs in different forms of a graph using configurations created by nodered.
